title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3519 East Walnut Street in Pearland, Texas, as the Tom Reid Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 3519 East Walnut Street in Pearland, Texas, as the "Tom Reid Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Postal Service building in Pearland, Texas, after Tom Reid.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 3519 East Walnut Street in Pearland, Texas, as the Tom Reid Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021, when it was signed.
